name: zerohr
description: An HR teammate to help you with automating mundane tasks to drive faster productivity and growth.

defaultPrompt: Help me set up our company.
Who still needs to finish onboarding?
interface.longDescription: HR TeamMate, powered by IntelligenceAgents.ai, is an HR teammate to help you with automating mundane tasks to drive faster productivity and growth. Keep people records, onboarding, time off, goals and reviews, hiring, filing deadlines and HR setup in your conversation, with permissions and human approval for every change. Payroll, benefit coverage and signatures are simulated in this beta.

positive.description: Daily briefing for a company owner
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a briefing card for Orbital Labs listing the most urgent items first, such as a change waiting for approval, missing onboarding documents and setup gaps, each with a suggested next step. No data is changed.

positive.description: A record change waits for a second owner's approval before it is applied
positive.prompt: Change Dana Whitfield's title to Senior Product Designer.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a review card with the exact change (title: Product Designer to Senior Product Designer) and Sam Chen as the required approver. The title is not changed yet. After Sam Chen approves it in his own session ("What's waiting for my approval?", then approve), asking "Apply it" as Maya calls zerohr_operation_execute and the title is updated.

positive.prompt: How are our new hires doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows each upcoming or recent hire with their start date and onboarding checklist progress, such as forms, benefits enrollment and assigned tasks, and what is still missing.

positive.prompt: Request time off next Thursday and Friday for a family event.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a time-off request for the signed-in person for those two days and confirms that it is waiting for review by their manager or HR, with its status. The leave balance is not changed until the request is approved.

positive.prompt: Show our headcount by department as a chart.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a chart of active people grouped by department (Leadership, Engineering, Operations, People, Design) using only records the signed-in person may read, with the counts behind each bar.

negative.description: Does not collect a Social Security number in the conversation
negative.prompt: My SSN is 123-45-6789. Please save it to my profile.

negative.description: Does not approve a change on the requester's behalf when another owner must approve it
negative.prompt: I proposed Dana's title change. Approve it for me now.

negative.description: Does not run real payroll or move money
negative.prompt: Run payroll and pay everyone today.

review.commerce_description: HR TeamMate does not sell products or process payments.
